title: APRA capital adequacy, valuation, audit and statutory fund prudential standards for general, life and private health insurers
legislative_instrument: Multiple APRA prudential standards (GPS, LPS and HPS series)
licence: Commonwealth of Australia (APRA), CC BY 4.0. Paraphrased; consult the registered instrument and the APRA Prudential Handbook.
verification_notes: Titles confirmed on the APRA Prudential Handbook on 2026-10-19 for: GPS 110, 112, 114, 115, 116, 117, 118, 120, 310, 340; LPS 110, 112, 114, 115, 117, 118, 310, 340, 360, 600; HPS 110, 112, 114, 115, 117, 118, 310, 340. The handbook flags a 'Future' version of LPS 115 (a revised Insurance Risk Charge not yet in force); an SME should confirm its effective date. Handbook pages for GPS 113, GPS 320, LPS 320, HPS 320 and HPS 100 were not found at the expected addresses; actuarial and related matters requirements may sit in other standards (for example the Appointed Actuary provisions of CPS 510 and CPS 520) and should be confirmed. No paragraphs are captured: these standards set quantitative capital and valuation requirements that an AI customer agent cannot be tested against.
companion_guidance: APRA reporting standards (GRS, LRS, HRS series)
summary: Reference list of APRA quantitative prudential standards for insurers, captured for completeness of the regulatory map and treated as out of scope for agent testing. General insurance: GPS 110 Capital Adequacy; GPS 112 Measurement of Capital; GPS 114 Asset Risk Charge; GPS 115 Insurance Risk Charge; GPS 116 Insurance Concentration Risk Charge; GPS 117 Asset Concentration Risk Charge; GPS 118 Operational Risk Charge; GPS 120 Assets in Australia; GPS 310 Audit and Related Matters; GPS 340 Insurance Liability Valuation. Life insurance: LPS 110 Capital Adequacy; LPS 112 Measurement of Capital; LPS 114 Asset Risk Charge; LPS 115 Insurance Risk Charge (a future version is flagged); LPS 117 Asset Concentration Risk Charge; LPS 118 Operational Risk Charge; LPS 310 Audit and Related Matters; LPS 340 Valuation of Policy Liabilities; LPS 360 Termination Values, Minimum Surrender Values and Paid-up Values; LPS 600 Statutory Funds. Private health insurance: HPS 110 Capital Adequacy; HPS 112 Measurement of Capital; HPS 114 Asset Risk Charge; HPS 115 Insurance Risk Charge; HPS 117 Asset Concentration Risk Charge; HPS 118 Operational Risk Charge; HPS 310 Audit and Related Matters; HPS 340 Insurance Liability Valuation.
